column1: # The checks of shell/time-storage.nsh on aarch64, whose PL031RealTimeClockLib returns
# PL031RealTimeClockLib.c). See check-shell-log.sh. TerminalDxe prints a character outside ASCII
# as "?" on ArmVirt's serial terminal, so the checks of texts that cite "§" compare them with "?"
# set reads GetWakeupTime() first, so it refuses before any write

column3: .error_message == "cannot set question \"Wake-up time\": the wake-up time cannot be read: GetWakeupTime(): UNSUPPORTED"
.error_message == "cannot set question \"Wake-up date\": the wake-up time cannot be read: GetWakeupTime(): UNSUPPORTED"

column1: # DateTimeData as publish-hiidb creates it: 2024-02-29 at byte 0, 12:34:56 at byte 4
# the TIME suppresses its second: get shows dashes there, which set takes and keeps

column3: (.error_message | gsub("§"; "?")) == "the second of this TIME is suppressed (UEFI 2.11 ?33.2.5.4.11): give dashes there, which keep it"
